phase: Phase 6 - Market Tab (Dashboard, 8 Movers Sub-Tabs, Scanners, Watchlist & Modals) Quantitative & Edge-Case Audit

criticalFindings: MKT-TEST-01: TopSearchBar dropdown (zIndex: 10000) overlays the Spotlight Card ('LIVE QUOTE') directly below it, blocking clicks on 'Open Full Stock Detail & Analysis' and 'Hero Chart' until the user manually clicks 'Close ✕'. Additionally, TopSearchBar (zIndex: 1000) bleeds over the SubIndicesModal drawer header (BUG-054).

MKT-TEST-10: Watchlist & Breakout Alerts header badge renders watchedOrAlertSymbols.length (total watched count) instead of watchedStocks.length (filtered count when topSearch is active), showing badge '2' when 1 or 0 rows are displayed (BUG-058).

MKT-TEST-11: Hero Index Card recalculates NEPSE 1D percentage change as ((2.64 / 2652.58) * 100).toFixed(2) = '+0.10%', contradicting the Top Header Bar, SubIndicesModal, and Fullscreen Index Modal which all show raw indices.nepse.pChange = '+0.09%'. ShareHubChart also prefixes NEPSE Index points with 'Rs. 2,655.22' (BUG-050).

MKT-TEST-12..17: Hero Index Chart timeframes 1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, and ALL all fetch fetchPriceHistory(sym, 500) without slicing the returned array to the selected timeframe window, displaying the exact same 500-session change '▲ +801.74 pts (+43.26%)' across all 6 buttons (BUG-051).
MKT-TEST-19: SubIndicesModal displays Open === High === Close for all 13 sector sub-indices (e.g., Microfinance Open: 4,502.51 · High: 4,502.51 | 4,502.51) and omits Low price (BUG-053).

MKT-TEST-21..22: Four-way Market Breadth & Unchanged count contradiction across the same screen: Breadth chip says 'Flat 21 (6%)' (336 traded scrips), clicking it or ChangeSummaryModal -> Unchanged shows '228 Scrips' (includes 207 untraded zero-volume scrips), Breadth bar says 'Advances 194 (58%)', and 5-Step Institutional Alpha Desk says 'Breadth: 62%' (omits unchanged from denominator) (BUG-052).

MKT-TEST-23..24 & 27..28: Movers '🔥 Breakouts' renders unrounded IEEE-754 float 'Pivot Rs. 856.8000000000001' on BENH; 'Top Gainers'/'Top Losers' are polluted by 10–50 share illiquid corporate debentures (CCBD88, GBILD86/87, SBLD89, GWFD83); 'Volume Surge' sorts by raw share volume (Rs. 10 mutual funds SEF2 1.32M, PSF 1.17M) instead of RVOL surge (BUG-055).

MKT-TEST-26 & 29..30: Orphan service shortcuts ('alpha-playbook', 'distribution-leaders') drop users onto the generic Services Hub (BUG-060); AlgorithmicSignalTrackRecord shows 0 signals when local radar API is offline and hardcodes outdated '+10% lockouts excluded' copy (BUG-057); NEPSE Calendar Modal badge shows generic 'Holiday: Public Holiday' instead of 'Holiday: तिहार (लक्ष्मी पूजा)' (BUG-061).

testInputs.expected: Slices history to 3 months (~65 trading sessions) and computes 3M point and % change.
testInputs.actual: Displays unsliced 500-day change: '▲ +801.74 pts (+43.26%) · 3M' (identical to 1W and 1M).

testInputs.expected: Slices history to 6 months (~130 trading sessions) and computes 6M point and % change.
testInputs.actual: Displays unsliced 500-day change: '▲ +801.74 pts (+43.26%) · 6M' (identical to 1W, 1M, 3M).

testInputs.category: Movers Card Sub-Tabs 7 & 8: Turnover & Volume Surge

testInputs.actual: Track Record modal shows 'Signal Ledger (0)', 'PROFIT FACTOR 0.00x' and outdated 'Unfillable +10% lockouts excluded'; BreakoutAlertDialog places early return before 6 useState/useEffect hooks and hardcodes 'pre-Dashain' during Tihar/Kartik.
